**[P2] Keep `deriveExecutionTraceId` aligned with this precedence**

The exported helper still reads only `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID`, although its contract says it derives the trace ID used by the plugins. On Managed Instances, it can therefore return a stale environment trace while the plugin uses the invocation-local header—or rejects an invalid local header and derives from the ARN. Extend the helper input to represent `xRayTraceId` and share this exact selection logic, including invalid-local suppression; update its tests and documentation accordingly.
